problem: Keeping SCI2 SCR=30 while streaming replies admits ECU transceiver self-echo into RDR; without draining it, overrun can invalidate the next request. Host J2534 TX-echo filtering does not address this ECU-side receive path.

stock_evidence.TX_enable: 1CEE: SCR AND AF clears RE/RIE; SCR AND5B plusOR20 enables TX only.
stock_evidence.RX_enable: 1CDC: SCR AND5B clears TE/TIE; SCR AND AF plusOR10 enables RX only.

DUAL_evidence.scope: Previously captured installed DUAL1.07 plaintext; no new executable or physical invocation
DUAL_evidence.byte_TX: FFFF3624 clears errors/drains existing RDR at3634..364C, submits TDR at3668, then polls RDRF and reads RDR at368E/3690, clearing RDRF at3694..3696, for each byte.

required_owned_contract: After validating the complete request, inspect residual RDR/error state so existing extra input is not silently accepted.
Disable RE before the first reply byte is submitted; keep it disabled for the entire reply.
Wait for actual TEND after the final checksum byte before re-enabling RE.
A TX-ready or TEND timeout remains terminal quiet failure, never success.
Do not interpret re-enabling RE as clearing preexisting error/RDR flags; handle them explicitly.
Verify final binary store domains and actual simulator self-echo injection, including an old-design negative control.

manual_qualification.ORER: Section15.2.6, PDF519/printed477: overrun preserves priorRDR and loses later receiveddata; receiving cannot continue until ORER is cleared.
manual_qualification.transfer_rule: Table15.11, PDF541/printed499, andtable15.13, PDF558/printed516: nextbyte completion withRDRF1 doesnot transferRSRtoRDR.
manual_qualification.receiver_disable: Section15.5.4, PDF558/printed516: RE0 initializesreceiver regardlessofstate; RE0doesnotclearSSRerrorflags.
manual_qualification.simulation_scope: A byte-completion echo schedule is an explicit input model, not measuredtransceiverdelay. SubsequentbyteswhileORER1 cannot become successfulRDRloads.

physical_limits: Exact line propagation, half-duplex turnaround and real provider timing remain physical inputs; the software receiver-control fix removes dependence on consuming each self-echo byte.
